gunmayhem2.swf: Gun Mayhem 2: More Mayhem, the original game (Armor Games release)
gunmayhem2_online.swf: Gun Mayhem 2 for Ruffle Together (up to 4 players online; the game's own local multiplayer, keys synced by Ruffle Together)
stealthhunter2_online.swf: Stealth Hunter 2 with the Multiplayer Everything co-op mod, for Ruffle
stealthhunter2_online_direct.swf: Stealth Hunter 2 co-op mod without the sponsor preloader (starts straight in the game), for Ruffle
BadIceCream_coop.swf: Bad Ice-Cream for Ruffle Together (lockstep online co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page, and no online mod code. Both players need this exact file.
BadIceCream_online.swf: Bad Ice-Cream online co-op for Ruffle Together (lockstep co-op in the ruffle-coop build, 1.0.0 and later): the game with only the fix for levels that would not start outside the web page. The same bytes as BadIceCream_coop.swf; both players need this exact file. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel).
TerritoryWar_online.swf: Territory War with the Multiplayer Everything online mod, red against blue on up to 4 PCs, room codes or direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE PLAY or F9)
BowMan_online.swf: Bow Man with the Multiplayer Everything online mod, 2 players (Ruffle only; VS Online on the title menu: room codes or Direct IP)
UltimateCrabBattle_online.swf: Ultimate Crab Battle with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; F9 opens the online panel)
AirBattle_online.swf: Air Battle with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP or F9)
RaftWars_online.swf: Raft Wars with 1-4 player turn co-op on the brothers' raft, online through Ruffle Together (--coop-keys gun-mayhem-2)
Intrusion_online.swf: Intrusion with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players through the campaign, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; Online Co-op panel on the main menu, F9 in a level)
StealthAssassin_online.swf: Stealth Assassin local co-op for Ruffle Together: 1-4 assassins in one game, each on their own keys (P1 arrows+Z+X, P2 WASD+T+Y, P3/P4 numpad), PLAYERS button on the mission menu, one extra target per extra player. No netcode; every player needs this exact file. 1 player is the original game. Replaces the old relay mod (F9 panel)
UltimateAssassin1_online.swf: Ultimate Assassin with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)
UltimateAssassin2_online.swf: Ultimate Assassin 2 with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)
UltimateAssassin3_online.swf: Ultimate Assassin 3 with the Multiplayer Everything online co-op mod, up to 4 players, one extra target per extra player, room codes or Direct IP (Ruffle; ONLINE CO-OP on the menu or F9)
